items.title_en: Modi govt is shaping a green future for every Indian by planting trees across India. Gladdened to see the Rudraksha sapling planted at Lok Bhawan campus in Arunachal Pradesh in February 2020 become a fully grown tree. Today planted a Red Sandalwood tree for an even better tomorrow.
items.title_zh: 阿米特·沙阿晒6年前种的小树苗已成大树，又种下一棵红檀
items.summary_en:
Modi govt is shaping a green future for every Indian by planting trees across India. Gladdened to see the Rudraksha sapling planted at Lok Bhawan campus in Arunachal Pradesh in February 2020 become a fully grown tree. 

Today planted a Red Sandalwood tree for an even better tomorrow.
items.summary_zh: 印度内政部长阿米特·沙阿发帖称，2020年2月他在阿鲁纳恰尔邦Lok Bhawan院内种下的菩提子（Rudraksha）树苗如今已长成大树，这次又种了一棵红檀树，称莫迪政府在全国植树、打造绿色未来。评论区有人吐槽“树苗6年长成大树，承诺也一个接一个”。

items.title_zh: E20乙醇汽油又被吐槽：车主称豪车频出燃油问题
items.summary_en:
From E20 to E13, and now people are once again reporting issues especially in cars like these. The reality is that most premium car owners don’t make much noise about it, so it rarely gets mainstream media attention.

I experienced something similar with a G-Wagon in Leh-Ladakh myself.

It genuinely feels like India is becoming less friendly for automotive enthusiasts. 

Vehicles are increasingly treated as disposable products buy, use, replace, and repeat. 

In the end, it seems to benefit corporations through more sales and governments through higher tax collections, while long-term ownership and enthusiast interests take a back seat.
items.summary_zh: 一名车主发视频称，从E20到E13，人们又在反映车辆问题，尤其是豪车，只是豪车车主很少发声所以媒体不报道；他说自己在列城-拉达克开奔驰G级时也遇到过类似情况，并认为印度越来越不友好于汽车爱好者，车辆被当成用完即换的消耗品。评论区有人指出连XP95高标号汽油也掺了20%乙醇，也有人提醒别什么问题都怪燃油。
